args.title: Remember and persist last export format in ExportButton
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Add functionality to the ExportButton component to remember the last export format chosen by the user by saving it in local storage and initializing the format state from this stored value. This will prevent the format from always defaulting to CSV and improve user experience by using their last chosen format automatically.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The ExportButton component currently defaults to CSV each time the report is opened. This change proposes to make it remember the last export format the user selected by saving it in local storage and initializing from it, so the user's preferred export format is preserved between uses.
